chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

For the one in a state of major ritual impurity (al-junub), it is permissible to walk through all mosques, but he may not sit in them, except for the Sacred Mosque (al-Masjid al-Haram) and the Mosque of the Messenger (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.جُنُب: One in a state of major ritual impurity, typically after sexual intercourse or ejaculation, requiring ghusl.
key_terms.مَسَاجِد: Mosques (plural of masjid), places of worship.
key_terms.مَسْجِدَ الرَّسُولِ: The Mosque of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) in Medina.

ai.seo_question: Can a person in the state of junub enter and sit in mosques?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the fiqh of *al-junub* (one with major ritual impurity), distinguishing between the permissibility of transit through any mosque and the restriction on remaining seated, except in the two holiest sanctuaries. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly view that *al-junub* is not in a state of *hadath* requiring exclusion from the mosque space itself, but rather lacks the full ritual purity required for prolonged residence or specific acts of worship like prayer, a nuance often debated against the Hanafi and Shafi'i positions which generally prohibit entry entirely until *ghusl* is performed.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, and Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘For the one with sexual impurity is that he can walk into the Masjids, all of them and he cannot sit in them, except for the Sacred Masjid, and Masjid of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> (where he can neither walk into nor sit in them)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn al-Hassan have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn abu Nasr from Jamil ibn Darraj who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

It is permissible for one after experiencing sexual relation to walk in all kinds of Masjid but he must not sit in them. This does not apply to Masjid al- Haram and Masjid of the Messenger of Allah.’”
